extraction_note: Values extracted from BEA fixed-assets tables using current-cost flows and chain-type quantity indexes. Component real volumes are expressed at 2019-price reference by current_cost_2019 * QI_t / QI_2019.
scope_note: Section 3 private fixed assets already contains residential private fixed assets in the accepted aggregate; Section 5 residential tables are therefore not added separately, avoiding double counting. Government components come from Section 7.
chain_nonadditivity_note: BEA chain-type quantity indexes are not strictly additive away from the reference year. Component real sums are therefore diagnostic and are reconciled to the accepted 71-sector real totals with an explicit residual.
